tagline: Free open-source resume tailoring and application tracking for job seekers.
overview: Restailor is a free, open-source workspace for tailoring resumes and tracking job applications. Candidates can compare fit, customize resumes for specific job descriptions, and use their own AI provider keys for model-powered resume help.
problem: Job seekers often struggle to customize their resumes for every application, leading to lower response rates. Managing multiple applications across different stages can become disorganized and difficult to track effectively.
solution: Restailor automates the resume customization process by analyzing job descriptions and generating tailored content that highlights relevant skills. It pairs that workflow with application tracking, analytics, BYOK provider access, and local budget accounting for the whole job search lifecycle.
coreCapabilities: BYOK AI-powered resume generation tailored to specific job descriptions
Candidate fit analysis to identify strengths and gaps
Application tracking with Kanban-style workflow stages
Real-time streaming feedback for content generation
Analytics dashboards for application history and conversion metrics
Provider-cost budget planning without Restailor markup
Secure data handling with encryption at rest
technicalOverview: The platform is built on a FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, utilizing PostgreSQL for data persistence. It employs a Redis-backed worker queue for asynchronous AI processing and Server-Sent Events for real-time updates. Security features include multi-factor authentication and column-level database encryption. The infrastructure is containerized with Docker for consistent deployment across environments.
